# frontend-ui-engineering

Use when the user asks for frontend ui engineering work.

## Workflow
1. Inspect existing design tokens and framework.
2. Define loading, empty, error, focus and mobile states.
3. Implement semantic markup and keyboard access.
4. Prefer CSS transforms for animation.
5. Validate in browser and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
